summary: Implemented the endpoint-ruleset builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py gets the EndpointResolverBuiltins str-enum (11 members, values per spec) and an enum import; botocore/args.py gets compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults on ClientArgsCreator, the EPRBuiltins import, and an endpoint_config=None default on _should_set_global_sts_endpoint; tests/unit/test_args.py gets TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with one test per behavioral criterion. Verification: test_args.py, test_regions.py, test_client.py and test_endpoint.py pass (443 tests) under the prepared venv. black, isort and flake8 were not run because black is not installed in the shared venv and I did not install packages. A manual awk check found no new lines over 79 columns; the one existing over-length line, args.py:315, predates this change. Nothing is committed.
